About

01

Hi, I'm Minh. I'm the person in the room who keeps asking "why" one more time than everyone else: why a number moved, why a customer left, why a process is slower than it should be. That habit is what pulled me toward data analytics. It's a discipline built entirely on chasing that question with evidence instead of guesses.

I'm currently in the Honors Program at Wake Technical Community College, working toward an Associate in Sciences and going deep on data analytics and statistics coursework. Before that, I studied Finance & Business Analytics at the University of Cincinnati's Lindner College of Business. I'm genuinely into this stuff, the kind of person who'd rather spend a Saturday cleaning a messy dataset than leave a question unanswered.

Outside of coursework, I volunteer as a data and strategy consultant for a nonprofit, and I like pairing traditional analysis with AI tools to move faster without cutting corners on rigor.

CompaClass Teacher Engagement Report

2026
Power BI
+

Built for CompaClass, an online learning platform, to give program managers a single view of teacher engagement: how many classes and courses each teacher runs, how many blog posts they've written, and how many students they've brought in through enrollment.

TRACKS
Classes · courses · blogs · students
SCOPE
Teacher-level and class-level breakdowns
FILTERS
Year, month, class, teacher
  • Cross-filterable views by year, month, class, and teacher surface which instructors are driving blog output and class volume
